---
title: "Vienna Applied Microeconomics Network"
---

We are a group of Vienna-based researchers working on topics in Labour and Applied Micro Economics, with the aim of meeting frequently to discuss research and policy, and to present our work. Our [**calendar**](calendar.qmd) provides information on research events and seminars taking place in Vienna on Labour and Applied Micro topics. Our [**monthly meetup**](meetups.qmd) takes place on the first Monday evening of each month during the academic year. During our [**annual workshop**](workshop.qmd), we present ongoing research on a broad range of Applied Economics topics.\
\
\
The Vienna Applied Micro Economics Network is a joint initiative of the Central European University, the University of Vienna, and the Vienna University of Economics and Business.



```{r dates}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
library(lubridate)
library(calendar)
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "English")
meetups2627h = c(ymd("20261207"), ymd("20270111"), ymd("20270301"), 
                ymd("20270404"), ymd("20270503"), ymd("20270607"))

next_dateh = min(meetups2627h[meetups2627h >= Sys.Date()])

ics_url = "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/viennaappliedmicroeconomics%40gmail.com/public/basic.ics"

calendar_page_url = "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=viennaappliedmicroeconomics%40gmail.com&ctz=Europe%2FVienna"

```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Calendar settings
tz <- "Europe/Vienna"

# Download calendar
ics_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".ics")
download.file(ics_url, ics_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)

ics_lines <- readLines(ics_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")

# Unfold lines (iCalendar formatting)
unfolded <- character()

for (line in ics_lines) {
  if (grepl("^[ \t]", line) && length(unfolded) > 0) {
    unfolded[length(unfolded)] <-
      paste0(unfolded[length(unfolded)], substring(line, 2))
  } else {
    unfolded <- c(unfolded, line)
  }
}

# Extract individual events
event_lines <- calendar::ic_list(unfolded)

get_prop <- function(x, property) {
  i <- which(names(x) == property |
             startsWith(names(x), paste0(property, ";")))

  if (length(i) == 0) return(NA_character_)

  unname(x[i[1]])
}

# Parse events
events <- lapply(event_lines, function(lines) {

  p <- calendar::ic_vector(lines)

  start_i <- which(names(p) == "DTSTART" |
                   startsWith(names(p), "DTSTART;"))

  if (length(start_i) == 0) return(NULL)

  start_key <- names(p)[start_i[1]]
  start_raw <- unname(p[start_i[1]])

  title <- get_prop(p, "SUMMARY")
  location <- get_prop(p, "LOCATION")
  status <- get_prop(p, "STATUS")
  event_url <- get_prop(p, "URL")

  if (identical(status, "CANCELLED")) return(NULL)

  if (is.na(title)) title <- "Untitled event"

  # All-day events
  all_day <- grepl("VALUE=DATE", start_key) ||
             grepl("^\\d{8}$", start_raw)

  if (all_day) {

    start_date <- as.Date(start_raw, format = "%Y%m%d")
    order_time <- as.POSIXct(start_date, tz = tz)
    time_label <- ""

  } else {

    # Determine timezone
    tz_match <- regmatches(
      start_key,
      regexpr("TZID=[^;]+", start_key)
    )

    event_tz <- if (length(tz_match) > 0) {
      gsub('"', "", sub("^TZID=", "", tz_match))
    } else {
      tz
    }

    # UTC events end in Z
    if (grepl("Z$", start_raw)) {
      event_tz <- "UTC"
      start_raw <- sub("Z$", "", start_raw)
    }

    fmt <- if (nchar(start_raw) == 15) {
      "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"
    } else {
      "%Y%m%dT%H%M"
    }

    order_time <- as.POSIXct(
      strptime(start_raw, format = fmt, tz = event_tz)
    )

    if (is.na(order_time)) return(NULL)

    start_date <- as.Date(order_time, tz = tz)
    time_label <- format(order_time, "%H:%M", tz = tz)
  }

  data.frame(
    title = title,
    date = as.character(start_date),
    time = time_label,
    location = ifelse(is.na(location), "", location),
    url = ifelse(is.na(event_url), "", event_url),
    all_day = all_day,
    order = as.numeric(order_time),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

events <- Filter(Negate(is.null), events)

# Find the next upcoming event
if (length(events) == 0) {

  cat("No upcoming events found in the calendar.")

} else {

  events <- do.call(rbind, events)

  now <- Sys.time()
  today <- as.Date(now, tz = tz)

  future <- events[
    ifelse(events$all_day,
           as.Date(events$date) >= today,
           events$order >= as.numeric(now)),
  ]

  if (nrow(future) == 0) {

    cat("No upcoming events found.")

  } else {

    next_event <- future[which.min(future$order), ]

    # English date formatting
    old_locale <- Sys.getlocale("LC_TIME")
    Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")

    date_label <- format(
      as.Date(next_event$date),
      "%A, %d %B %Y"
    )

    Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", old_locale)

    # Display announcement
    cat("###", "Next Applied Seminar", "\n\n", sep = " ")
    cat("**", next_event$title, sep = "")
    cat("**\n\n")
    cat("**", date_label, sep = "")

    if (next_event$time != "") {
      cat(" · ", next_event$time, sep = "")
    }

    cat("**\n\n")

    if (next_event$location != "") {
      cat("Location: ", next_event$location, "\n\n", sep = "")
    }

    target_url <- if (next_event$url != "") {
      next_event$url
    } else {
      calendar_page_url
    }

    cat("[View event in Google Calendar](", target_url, ")\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
